articles.title: Parish and Park Groups Team Up on Saturday Cleanup Day
articles.deck: Residents of Canal Park filled the hall on Wednesday to ask questions about the plan.
body: The plan calls for Saturday cleanup day along Carver Lane, with work expected to start in May. Organizers say the project is on schedule and that volunteers are still needed on Wednesday mornings.
Public works estimates the work will take about 36 weeks once it begins. The group has raised $48,000 so far and is asking for help with supplies and food.

Mariana Iwasaki, who has lived in Canal Park for 36 years, said the response has been better than anyone expected. The Canal Park Improvement Group will post updates on its bulletin board outside the library.

articles.title: Carl Reyes, 72, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Carl Reyes for the many years of service to Mill Hill.
body: Born in Mill Hill in the years after the war, Carl Reyes spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Mill Hill. Carl Reyes died in May at home on Hollis Street, at the age of 72.

articles.title: Letter: The Pocket Park on Fox Avenue Needs Attention
body: To the editor: Please keep the pocket park in the budget. Many of us on Fox Avenue use it every week.

To the editor: I have lived on Fox Avenue for 6 years, and I want to say what a difference the Bellwood Chapel has made. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Celia Lombardi, Eastgate

articles.title: Then & Now: the Mill Hill Town Hall, 1982 and 2020
articles.deck: A photo from the Millrace County Historical Society shows the same corner as it looked decades ago.
body: Most of the houses are still standing, though the porches and the trees have changed a good deal.
Someone took the same picture from the same spot this month, holding the camera at about the same height.
A 1982 photograph from the Millrace County Historical Society shows Ferry Street from the corner of Elm Drive.
